suggested_issue_title: README install command and NuGet badge reference Aspose.Imaging.Foss, which does not exist on nuget.org
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-02) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-imaging-foss/Aspose.Imaging-FOSS-for-.NET`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `a7c7314b18e1a5bd209fab38c15e72574337366f` on 2026-10-09T21:36Z.

## Summary

The Install section (README.md lines 62-64) says `dotnet add package Aspose.Imaging.Foss`, and the NuGet badge on line 4 links the package page. `src/Aspose.Imaging.Foss/Aspose.Imaging.Foss.csproj` declares `PackageId` `Aspose.Imaging.Foss`, but no such package is published on nuget.org, so the documented install fails.

## Environment

- Revision `a7c7314b18e1a5bd209fab38c15e72574337366f` (default branch `main`)
- .NET SDK 10.0.401

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
dotnet new console -n probe && cd probe
dotnet add package Aspose.Imaging.Foss
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://www.nuget.org/packages/Aspose.Imaging.Foss
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/aspose.imaging.foss/index.json
```

## Actual result

```
error: There are no versions available for the package 'Aspose.Imaging.Foss'.
404
404
```
For comparison `https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/aspose.imaging/index.json` returns 200, and the NuGet pages of `Aspose.Words.FOSS` and `Aspose.Cells.FOSS` return 200.

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:4` (badge), `README.md:62-64` (install command)
- `src/Aspose.Imaging.Foss/Aspose.Imaging.Foss.csproj:14` (`PackageId`)

## Evidence

- `dotnet add package Aspose.Imaging.Foss`: 2026-10-09T21:36Z: error: There are no versions available for the package 'Aspose.Imaging.Foss'.
- `https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/aspose.imaging.foss/index.json`: HTTP 404 on 2026-10-09T21:36Z
- `https://www.nuget.org/packages/Aspose.Imaging.Foss`: HTTP 404 on 2026-10-09T21:36Z (the README's NuGet badge target)
- `https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/aspose.imaging/index.json`: Control: HTTP 200, so the probe itself works
- `README.md`: lines 4 and 62-64 (revision a7c7314b18e1a5bd209fab38c15e72574337366f; unchanged at the live head)
